improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
improve.coach: Steady at about 64% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
improve.coach: 32% of matches overall, down to 20% recently. Keep chipping away.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Cool as the other side of the pillow. 73% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it. 50% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You touched the ball more than a nervous waiter touches a menu. There in 45% of your matches. Build your game around it.
